_note: Every competition Rayners Lane enter this season, and HONESTLY where each one stands. A cup with no fixtures in fixtures.json is not a bug and must not look like one — it means the draw hasn't been made. `state` drives the wording on fixtures.html. Only edit this when the club KNOWS something changed; an out-of-date 'awaiting draw' is better than an invented fixture. Sources are recorded so the next person knows where to check.

_brandNote: Competition identity for match cards is resolved from these entries by js/competition-brand.js — one source of truth for every surface. `logo` is null until an OFFICIAL asset is obtained; a null logo makes cards fall back to the text identity, which is the intended behaviour, not a failure. Never populate `logo` from a logo-aggregator site: FA competition marks are issued by The Association to competing clubs and must be the issued image.
